posts.description: 5 Palabras is a five-letter word guessing game built for Latin American Spanish — with a rioplatense dictionary feel, not a generic Iberian word list. Guess each word; correct letters lock in place and hints help when stuck. Play Unlimited, Daily, or Fever against the clock. Three modes, LATAM/rioplatense Spanish, hints, no accounts, no in-app purchases, and offline after install. Like Wordle, but for Spanish that matches LATAM — especially the Río de la Plata.

posts.name: Abode
posts.tagline: A personal finance dashboard that replaces spreadsheets.
posts.description: Abode is a personal finance dashboard built to replace spreadsheets. Add an expense, choose your preferred income split, and you'll see your monthly income moving right away. Manage your income effectively with full oversight across savings pots, and net worth update right away. No monthly tabs, no manual formulas. One screen, desktop or mobile.

posts.name: ClubFines
posts.tagline: Less admin, more team spirit. All in one app
posts.description: ClubFines helps treasurers, coaches, and team captains manage fines, players, and payments in one shared place. Replace spreadsheets and chat lists with a clear overview your club can rely on. TRACK TEAM FINES Choose a player, select a fine, review the details, and save. Every amount, date, and payment status stays organized. BUILD YOUR OWN CATALOG Create categories and define amounts for every offense. Start with our football template containing 12 common fines or build your own catalog.

posts.name: iPhone app Which Is Older? Art Quiz
posts.tagline: Guess which artwork is older — from 247,000 works
posts.description: Compare two artworks and guess which one is older. No art knowledge needed—just look, think, and choose. Questions are drawn from data on approximately 247,000 works from The Metropolitan Museum of Art’s Open Access collection. After each answer, discover the real dates and artwork details. Free to download on iPhone.

posts.name: Pasiv
posts.tagline: Your idle gaming PC earns crypto while you sleep
posts.description: Pasiv turns an idle graphics card — or a spare CPU — into crypto. One button, no account. The pool pays your wallet directly (non-custodial), Auto mode picks whichever coin pays most, and the only fee is 4% on Monero. macOS, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: TwiFlux
posts.tagline: Download videos, images & more from Twitter/X
posts.description: TwiFlux is a free collection of browser-based tools for Twitter/X. It helps you quickly download videos, images, GIFs, and handle other common X-related tasks without installing software or creating an account. Everything is designed to be fast, simple, and easy to use. This is just the beginning — I’ll keep adding more useful tools based on feedback from the community.

posts.name: Digging Code
posts.tagline: Practical tools, knowledge, and resources for developers
posts.description: Digging Code is a developer platform built around practical coding knowledge, useful tools, and open-source projects. It brings together real-world articles, development tips, vetted packages, Laravel tools, and community contributions — helping developers solve problems faster, write cleaner code, and discover useful resources without the noise. 🌐

posts.name: CargoMode
posts.tagline: AI freight ops: inbox docs → CargoWise sync
posts.description: CargoMode is AI for freight ops on CargoWise. Agents read your inbox and shipping documents, extract fields with confidence scores, draft quotes and bookings, then sync validated data into CargoWise — nothing commits until a human approves. Freight-native extraction for B/Ls, invoices and packing lists, plus RFQ quoting and invoice reconciliation. In daily production use; Bad Boy Labs product.

It helps you quickly download videos, images, GIFs, and handle other common X-related tasks without installing software or creating an account. Everything is designed to be fast, simple, and easy to use. This is just the beginning — I’ll keep adding more useful tools based on feedback from the community.

posts.name: verso.md
posts.tagline: Collaborative specs that live where your code lives
posts.description: Most spec tools can’t see your codebase or push a file to the repo. Most Markdown editors don’t offer collaboration or persistent drafts. Verso combines both: write PRDs with your team in a real editor, let repo-aware AI work from the actual code, then publish the spec to GitHub as a commit or pull request. Verso also flags when implementation drifts from the document.

posts.name: Free Tattoo Designer
posts.tagline: AI tattoo studio — design, place, share with your artist
posts.description: Free Tattoo Designer is an AI-powered tattoo studio for people who want to plan ink before they sit in the chair. Describe your idea, tune style and placement, generate concepts, try them on a photo, and hand a clear brief to your artist or friends. Built for first-timers and collectors who are tired of vague Pinterest boards.

posts.name: SnapDo
posts.tagline: Turn screenshots and photos into useful actions
posts.description: SnapDo turns photos, screenshots, receipts and pasted text into editable actions on iPhone. Keep the workflow private and offline with practical templates, no account, and a one-time lifetime unlock.

posts.name: ESP32 Claude Code Monitor
posts.tagline: Approve Claude Code tool calls with a tap, off your screen
posts.description: See every Claude Code session's state (running, waiting, stopped) live on a tiny ESP32-S3 touchscreen, and approve or deny tool permission requests by tapping YES/NO on the board itself, no alt-tabbing back to the terminal or editor. It's a $20 open-source hardware sidekick: a local Go server tracks sessions via Claude Code hooks, and the board polls it over Wi-Fi. Falls back to the normal terminal prompt if nobody taps in time, so it never blocks your flow.

posts.name: Screen Index
posts.tagline: Find, Edit, Organize Screenshots on your Mac
posts.description: Find and edit Mac screenshots by any clue you remember. Search from any app, file new captures quickly, and keep originals in real Finder folders.

posts.name: GrowsChat
posts.tagline: Random chat with real people, fully moderated
posts.description: GrowsChat is a random chat platform built on one rule: AI is always disclosed, never pretending to be human. No account needed to start a conversation. Every video call includes a safety check, and one tap ends a conversation that's gone wrong. Built solo after a first version taught hard lessons about cost and trust. V2 is rebuilt from scratch with honesty, low friction, and safety as defaults, not features.

posts.name: WitnessReadyNow
posts.tagline: Find the right witness, ready now!
posts.description: Finding a witness for a legal document signing has always been a nightmare — phone calls, Facebook posts, neighbors' doors. WitnessReadyNow fixes that. Submit a request, available professional witnesses near your signing location are notified instantly. 283 witnesses across 38 states, built entirely through organic word of mouth. We also created a brand new gig economy job category — professional witnessing. Free for founding members permanently.

posts.name: Moe
posts.tagline: Your Mac's assistant. Just talk. Free.
posts.description: Every other AI gives you a text box and forgets you the moment you close it. Moe lives on your Mac, listens when you talk, remembers everything you've told it, and actually does the work — in your mail, your calendar, your apps. Say it once. You won't have to explain yourself again.

posts.name: Vitaebase
posts.tagline: An evidence-graded map of the science behind longevity
posts.description: Vitaebase turns longevity research into one interactive map. Every intervention — exercise, nutrition, sleep, supplements, and more — is scored on Evidence Strength and Potential Impact, sourced from real PubMed studies (870+ and counting). Build your own stack, get a personalized Longevity Score, and ask Vitaebase AI research questions about your own data. No supplements to sell, no affiliate links — just the evidence, mapped.

posts.name: BrideMatch - Virtual Wedding Dress TryOn
posts.tagline: Virtually try on wedding dresses from any website
posts.description: BrideMatch is a virtual wedding dress try-on Chrome extension designed to make online bridal shopping easier. Instead of trying to imagine how a dress might look on you, simply browse wedding dresses online, hover over any dress image, click “Try on,” and see the selected dress on your own photo. No need to download images, copy product links, or switch between different tools. BrideMatch brings the virtual fitting room directly into the websites where you already shop.

posts.name: JL Image Attributes
posts.tagline: Auto fills in the title, alt and description attributes.
posts.description: JL Image Attributes is a WordPress plugin that automatically fills in alt attributes, titles, and descriptions for every image you upload to your site. Its goal is to boost your Google Images rankings and strengthen your content's accessibility without requiring you to touch a single line of code or spend hours manually tagging files. If you landed here looking for a way to automate image SEO in WordPress.

posts.name: Supertime
posts.tagline: Daily games with friends
posts.description: Supertime brings daily word and logic games into one iPhone app. With 13 games and more being added each month, you can share results with friends or groups, compare scores on global the leaderboard and find your new favorite break in your day.

posts.name: PaisaProof
posts.tagline: Stops impulse UPI & card spends before they happen
posts.description: PaisaProof catches impulse spends the moment they happen — UPI or card — and shows what that money becomes if invested instead. No bank login, no manual entry, runs fully on-device. Earn rewards for the spends you actually skip.

posts.name: BlurShield
posts.tagline: Blur and lock your mac the moment your lid starts closing
posts.description: BlurShield blurs your screen the instant your lid starts closing, a paired device goes out of range, or you hit a keyboard shortcut — Touch ID brings it right back. Choose what protects you: a lid-angle sensor, a Bluetooth device that walks out of range with you, or a shortcut you trigger yourself. BlurShield also includes Espresso, a caffeinate replacement built in: keep your Mac awake through long builds, renders, or downloads, without digging through Energy Saver settings every time.

posts.name: Meet Lula
posts.tagline: Get your brand cited where customers and AI look
posts.description: Lula is an AI digital PR agent that finds relevant journalist requests, media openings and authority gaps, develops credible angles and carries out outreach and submissions within your rules. Then it shows you what turned into coverage, backlinks, brand mentions, citations and traffic.
